biotools.summary: How much mobile phone radiation are we exposed to in everyday life? The ETAIN 5G Scientist app shows maps of mobile phone radiation across Europe. It continuously calculates the radiation from cell towers and how strongly your own device transmits during a phone call. The app was developed in the citizen research project ETAIN (Exposure To electromAgnetic fIelds and plaNetary health), which is funded by the EU. ETAIN investigates the effects of mobile phone radiation on human health and on biodiversity. The app is available for Android phones in the Google Play Store. Everyone who uses the app contributes to the research.
